actors.name: Ravi
actors.private_context: Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback. He is 40,000 rupees below the seller's asking price. He can decide to offer a different price or accept the seller's counteroffer. He has three days before the listing expires.

actors.name: Seller
actors.private_context: The seller has listed a 2019 hatchback at a certain price. They are 40,000 rupees above Ravi's offer. They can decide to accept, reject, or counteroffer. The listing expires in three days.

shared_context: Ravi and the seller are in contact regarding the sale of a 2019 hatchback. The current price difference is 40,000 rupees. The seller's listing will expire on 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30.

starting_events.description: Ravi and the seller are aware of the 40,000 rupee gap. No agreement has been reached yet.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller have agreed on a price (e.g., a message accepting an offer, a signed agreement, or a payment). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
